resource: LOGOUT_INTENT commands (command type 23, capability 21) outstanding per GameSession
allocation_impact: One flag per served GameSession connection, held while a logout command is being decided; nothing persisted. The command loop reads no further command while a logout runs, so a second logout before the first result is a protocol error that ends the connection.
boundary_tests: max=1: apps/game-server/src/gameplay_transport/logout_tests.rs a single logout is decided and answered
max+1=2: the same tests refuse a second logout while the first is outstanding as a protocol error
